subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-update for installed ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, and operator-control policy must gate it?
rationale: The implementation is feasible but would automatically replace third-party code and add public config plus gateway lifecycle behavior, so automation should not choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Design gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define default-off policy, provenance and trust checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or rollback semantics, audit logging, and failure behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Leave `openclaw skills update` and `openclaw plugins update` as the supported path and document cron or external scheduling for operators who accept the risk.

options.title: Split security prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, rollback, provenance, and skill/plugin update safety as prerequisite work before deciding on background automation.

recommendation.title: Design gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define default-off policy, provenance and trust checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or rollback semantics, audit logging, and failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged-history signal across package auto-update, native ClawHub install flows, plugin update extraction, and plugin update tracking.
